scripts.typegen: SQLX_OFFLINE=true CARGO_TARGET_DIR=../target cargo run --bin gen_types --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml && openapi-typescript openapi.json -o src/shared/api/generated/schema.d.ts
scripts.build:admin: APP_TARGET=admin vite build && cp dist/admin/admin.html dist/admin/index.html && cp public/_redirects dist/admin/_redirects
scripts.build:owner: APP_TARGET=owner vite build && cp dist/owner/owner.html dist/owner/index.html && cp public/_redirects dist/owner/_redirects
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:admin && npm run build:owner
